Powers/Qualities

Assign one of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to the @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.kTRnwcMJLHbZopWQ]{Speed} power. If you already have @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.kTRnwcMJLHbZopWQ]{Speed}, either skip it or swap the die with one of your new dice.

Assign one or more of the remaining dice to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.iJ4lw3vOpXIC2Mwp]{Agility}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.5r7HjDoWoSVm9d5e]{Intangibility}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.DEqpcIHX8qEVJeag]{Lightning Calculator}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.9oftF6dPbn9LtnEz]{Vitality}

• Select from Mobility powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• Select from Mental qualities category

• Select from Physical qualities category
